questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the “Niveshak Shivir” initiative: 1. The initiative was launched by the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) in collaboration with SEBI. 2. Investor Helpdesks offer on-ground support for direct interaction with company representatives and Registrars and Transfer Agents (RTAs). 3. The streamlined claim process provides guidance exclusively for shareholders holding assets in physical form. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The “Niveshak Shivir” (Investor Camp) is a collaborative nationwide initiative launched by the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), a statutory body under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).

Statement 2 is correct: Niveshak Shivir is to eliminate intermediaries (like unauthorised agents or brokers). By setting up these helpdesks, the camps allow investors to have direct, face-to-face interactions with company representatives and Registrars and Transfer Agents (RTAs). This provides on-the-spot support for KYC updation, nomination filings, and immediate grievance redressal.

Statement 3 is incorrect: Shareholders whose shares are due for transfer to the IEPFA can seek assistance based on their holding type. Those holding dematerialised shares should contact the respective company for clarification and support, while holders of physical share certificates should check their status on the IEPFA website and, if already transferred, initiate a claim by filing Form IEPF-5. About IEPFA

The Government of India established the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Its mandate is to promote investor awareness, ensure effective grievance redressal, and facilitate the recovery of unclaimed investments through accessible and user-friendly platforms.

questions.q: The Central Apprenticeship Council (CAC) has recommended an increase of what percentage in the monthly stipend for youth under national apprenticeship schemes?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation: The 38th meeting of the Central Apprenticeship Council, chaired by the Minister of State (Independent Charge) for the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, recommended a 36% increase in stipends under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme and the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme.

questions.q: Which of the following locations has been designated to host India’s first Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Special Economic Zone (SEZ)?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation: India’s first Artificial Intelligence-focused Special Economic Zone (AI-based SEZ) is being established in Nava Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The project is being developed by RackBank Datacenters Pvt. Ltd., a company known for building carbon-neutral data centres. With an investment of nearly ₹1,000 crore, the SEZ aims to promote advanced AI infrastructure, data processing, and technological innovation, marking a significant step in India’s digital and AI-driven development.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the SPICED scheme: 1. It is an initiative under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to enhance the productivity of small and large cardamom. 2. It extends financial assistance to both farmers and Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: Sustainability in the Spice Sector through Progressive, Innovative, and Collaborative Interventions for Export Development (SPICED) is a scheme launched by the Spices Board under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. It provides financial assistance through various components to promote sustainability, innovation, and export growth in India’s spices sector.

Statement 2 is correct: The scheme offers financial support to farmers and Farmer Producer Organisations for purchasing essential post-harvest equipment such as spice polishers, turmeric boilers, mint distillation units, and threshing machines.

questions.q: Consider the following pharmaceutical products: 1. Neomycin 2. Gentamycin 3. Ciprofloxacin 4. Diclofenac Sodium Which of the products given above are included in the fresh rollout of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme announced by the Department of Pharmaceuticals?

The Department of Pharmaceuticals has announced a fresh rollout of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme covering 11 products.

questions.q: What name have astronomers given to the recent major solar eruption of superheated plasma?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
The “Bird-wing” event refers to a massive solar eruption observed by NASA satellites. It gained this name due to its visually striking shape, where superheated plasma tore away from the Sun’s northern hemisphere in sweeping, wing-like formations.

The event was a complex eruption involving both a Solar Flare (a burst of electromagnetic radiation) and a Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) (a massive cloud of magnetised plasma).

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the SWOT Satellite: 1. It is a joint mission of NASA and French Space Agency, CNES. 2. It measures tiny changes in the height of water across oceans, lakes, and rivers. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The SWOT (Surface Water and Ocean Topography) Satellite is a collaborative mission between NASA and the French space agency CNES. Other international partners have also contributed to the mission. It was launched to improve scientific understanding of Earth’s surface water and ocean systems.

Statement 2 is correct: SWOT satellite can detect and measure small variations in water height across oceans, rivers, lakes, and reservoirs. These measurements help in studying sea-level rise, water management, climate change, and flood forecasting.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding DHRUVA: 1. It is released by the Department of Telecommunications to create a national Digital Address Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). 2. It is based on the concept of Address-as-aService (AaaS). 3. It aims to restrict address data sharing only to government agencies. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is incorrect: DHRUVA was released by the Department of Posts, not the Department of Telecommunications. It is a policy framework for creating a national Digital Address Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for India.

Statement 2 is correct: The idea of Addressas-a-Service (AaaS) is central to DHRUVA. It enables citizens, corporations, and governmental organisations to share verified address data in real time, with consent.

Statement 3 is incorrect: DHRUVA aims to create a collaborative ecosystem involving both government and private sector stakeholders. It supports secure, consent-based sharing of address data rather than restricting it only to government agencies.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the BharatGen initiative: 1. It is India’s first indigenously developed, multimodal AI model designed to offer solutions in 22 Indian languages. 2. It aims to revolutionise AI development across India’s linguistic and cultural spectrum Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: BharatGen is India’s first indigenous multimodal Artificial Intelligence initiative. It has been developed to provide AIbased solutions across 22 Indian languages, thereby addressing India’s linguistic diversity. It is developed under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NMICPS) and implemented through TIH Foundation for IoT and IoE at IIT Bombay.

Statement 2 is correct: BharatGen aims to revolutionise AI development across India’s linguistic and cultural spectrum. The initiative is supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and brings together a robust consortium of leading academic institutions, experts, and innovators.

questions.q: Which organisation launched the C CARES Version 2.0 web portal for providing services related to provident fund and pension schemes?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation: The C-CARES Version 2.0 (Coal Mines Provident Fund Organisation Computerisation of Accounts and Records Electronic System) web portal was launched by the Union Minister of Coal and Mines. The technology was developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC). The Organisation is presently rendering services to about 3.3 lakh Provident Fund subscribers and 6.3 lakh pensioners of coal sector.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the Bharat Forecast System (BFS): 1. It provides weather forecasts at a spatial resolution of 6 kilometres. 2. It was developed indigenously by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Pune. 3. It has replaced the older 20-km resolution forecasting model used by the India Meteorological Department. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The Bharat Forecast System (BFS) is a high-resolution weather forecasting model that delivers forecasts at an ultra-fine spatial resolution of 6 km. This gives India an advantage over several global forecasting systems that generally operate at resolutions between 9 and 14 km.

Statement 2 is correct: The BFS was developed indigenously by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM), Pune. It represents an important achievement under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative in climate science and weather forecasting.

Statement 3 is incorrect: The BFS replaced the earlier 12-km resolution forecasting model, not a 20-km model. The upgraded system is now operational at the India Meteorological Department (IMD).

questions.q: India’s first gene-edited sheep was developed in which state/UT?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation: Researchers from the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences (SKUAST), Srinagar, have developed India’s first gene-edited sheep. Achieved after four years of research, the gene-editing is expected to increase the animal’s muscle mass by about 30%. This breakthrough follows the recent development of India’s first gene-edited rice variety.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding Axiom Mission 4: 1. It is organised by Axiom Space in collaboration with NASA, SpaceX, and ISRO. 2. The mission aims to conduct scientific experiments in microgravity. 3. It marks India’s first human spaceflight mission ever. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: Axiom Mission 4 (Ax- 4) is the fourth private astronaut mission to the International Space Station and is being organised by Axiom Space in partnership with NASA, SpaceX, and ISRO. The mission reflects growing international and commercial cooperation in space exploration.

Statement 2 is correct: The major objectives of Ax-4 is to carry out scientific research in microgravity conditions. The experiments focus on areas such as materials science, biology, Earth observation, and life sciences, along with promoting commercial activities in low Earth orbit.

Statement 3 is incorrect: Ax-4 does not mark India’s first human spaceflight mission. India had already sent Rakesh Sharma to space in 1984 aboard a Soviet mission. However, Ax-4 is significant because it marks India’s return to human spaceflight after 41 years.

questions.q: Recently, researchers from which country developed a plastic that dissolves in seawater within hours?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Researchers in Japan have developed a plastic that dissolves in seawater within hours, offering up a potential solution for a modern-day scourge polluting oceans and harming wildlife.

It is a supramolecular polymer made from a combination of sodium hexametaphosphate (a common food additive) and guanidinium-based monomers.

questions.q: The Shirui Lily Festival was recently inaugurated in which state?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
The Shirui Lily Festival was recently inaugurated in the state of Manipur. The festival is associated with the famous Shirui Lily, a rare flower found only on the Shirui Hills in the Ukhrul district of Manipur. Blooming mainly between late May and early June, the flower has gained international recognition because of its uniqueness and limited geographical distribution.

The festival is organised to promote the cultural heritage, tourism potential, and ecological importance of the region, while also encouraging eco-tourism and local development

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the World Hydrogen Summit, 2025: 1. The 2025 World Hydrogen Summit was held in Rotterdam, the Netherlands 2. India has set a target to achieve energy independence by 2047 and reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2070. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct

questions.q: The Zangezur Corridor is primarily associated with connecting Azerbaijan to which autonomous region?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct

The Zangezur Corridor will provide uninterrupted transportation between the main territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan and the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, while also serving as a vital new segment of both the East-West and NorthSouth transport corridors.

questions.q: The recently launched Clean Plant Programme initially focuses on which of the following crops?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct

The Clean Plant Programme was announced during India’s first International Agri Hackathon held in Pune.

The programme aims to provide disease-free planting material for important horticultural crops. They help bridge the urban-rural digital divide by providing citizens easy access to digital services, certificates, and welfare schemes at the local level.

questions.q: What is the specific polymer used by Kamalpur Nagar Panchayat in Tripura to create compostable bags as a sustainable alternative to single-use plastic?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
The Kamalpur Nagar Panchayat in the Dhalai district of Tripura has gained national attention for its proactive measures against single-use plastic (SUP). To provide a sustainable alternative, they have introduced compostable bags specifically manufactured using Polybutylene Adipate Terephthalate (PBAT).

Polybutylene Adipate Terephthalate: It is a biodegradable and compostable random copolymer. Unlike traditional plastics like PET or HDPE, which are derived from petroleum and persist in the environment for centuries, PBAT is designed to break down fully in composting conditions without leaving toxic residues.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the INSPIRE Programme: 1. It is implemented by the Department of Science & Technology to strengthen India’s science and technology human resource base. 2. Selection under the INSPIRE scheme is primarily based on a nationwide competitive examination conducted annually. 3. It supports students from school level up to university education to encourage careers in scientific research. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE) is a flagship program of the Department of Science & Technology (DST). Its core objective is to attract talent to the study of science at an early age and build the required critical human resource pool for strengthening the Science & Technology (S&T) system and R&D base.

Statement 2 is incorrect: A unique feature of the INSPIRE programme is that it does not conduct competitive exams for selection. questions.q: Regarding the recent launch by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE) on World Environment Day 2025, which of the following is the primary objective of the ‘Waste Picker Enumeration App’?

options.C: To profile and identify waste pickers to extend benefits under the NAMASTE Scheme.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding INSV Kaundinya: 1. It is inspired by a fifth-century ship depicted in the Ajanta cave paintings. 2. Statement 2 is correct: The vessel is named after Kaundinya, a legendary figure often credited in historical and mythological accounts with establishing early maritime and cultural links between India and Southeast Asia (specifically the Funan Kingdom in present-day Cambodia/ Vietnam). The name serves as a tribute to the ancient Indian mariners who navigated the Indian Ocean for trade and cultural exchange.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding ‘Panchshul Pulse’: 1. It is the first FM radio station launched by the Indian Army in Uttarakhand. 2. Tele-density is the number of telephone connections per 100 people. In Bihar, this means roughly 36 out of every 100 people still do not have a registered telephone connection (wireless or wireline).

questions.q: Which state recently became the first in India to allow voting through mobile phones during municipal polls?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Bihar became the first state in India to introduce mobile phone-based voting during municipal polls. The initiative was aimed at improving voter participation and making the electoral process more

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the NAVYA programme: 1. It was launched jointly by the Ministry of Women and Child Development and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 2. Statement 1 is correct: NAVYA was launched in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh by the Ministry of Women and Child Development in convergence with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. The programme was jointly launched by Jayant Chaudhary and Savitri Thakur.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the 11th India Maize Summit 2025: 1. The summit was jointly organized by FICCI and Indian Institute of Maize Research in New Delhi. 2. India aims to increase maize production to 86 million tonnes by 2047. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The 11th India Maize Summit 2025 was inaugurated by Shivraj Singh Chouhan in New Delhi. The summit was jointly organized by FICCI and the Indian Institute of Maize Research (ICAR-IIMR) to promote reforms and growth in India’s maize sector.

The country aims to increase maize production from the current level of over 42 million tonnes to 86 million tonnes by 2047. India’s average maize yield is about 3.7 tonnes per hectare, which is still lower than the global average, making research, improved seeds, and farmer education important policy priorities.

questions.q: Which country recently became the first Caribbean nation to enable transactions through India’s BHIM app using the Unified Payments Interface?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Trinidad and Tobago became the first Caribbean nation to enable transactions through India’s BHIM app using the Unified Payments Interface (UPI).

The development reflects India’s growing digital financial cooperation with other countries and highlights the global expansion of UPI-based payment systems. It is also an important step in strengthening fintech and economic ties between India and Caribbean nations.

questions.q: Which organization recently became India’s first maritime-focused NBFC to begin lending operations worth about ₹4,300 crore?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited (SMFCL) is India’s first maritime-focused non-banking financial company (NBFC). It recently started lending operations by sanctioning loans worth around ₹4,300 crore, aimed at strengthening India’s maritime finance ecosystem.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the C-FLOOD Platform: 1. It is a Unified Inundation Forecasting System developed jointly by C-DAC Pune and the Central Water Commission. 2. questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: C-FLOOD Platform is a Unified Inundation Forecasting System developed collaboratively by Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), Pune and the Central Water Commission under the Ministry of Jal Shakti. The initiative is implemented under the National Supercomputing Mission jointly steered by MeitY and DST.

questions.q: Which of the following substances was used by the Delhi Government during in recent artificial rain?

questions.q: Which of the following Physical Characteristics are correct regarding the recently discovered Altermagnetism? 1. It exhibits no net magnetisation as alternating spins cancel out externally. 2. It shows spin-split electronic bands similar to those observed in ferromagnets. 3. Its spin arrangement is governed by crystal symmetry such as rotations and reflections. 4. It operates on slow spin dynamics, typically in millisecond time scales. Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: Similar to traditional antiferromagnets, altermagnets exhibit no net macroscopic magnetization. Their adjacent magnetic moments (spins) alternate in direction and perfectly cancel each other out externally, meaning they do not generate stray magnetic fields.

Statement 2 is correct: This is the defining breakthrough of altermagnets. Despite having absolutely zero net magnetization, they exhibit strongly spin-split electronic bands in momentum space. Historically, such spin polarization was thought to be exclusive to ferromagnets. Altermagnets combine the zero net magnetization of antiferromagnets with the spin-polarization characteristics of ferromagnets.

Statement 3 is correct: The unique properties of altermagnets arise from their specific crystal symmetries. In an altermagnet, the sublattices with opposite spins are not just translated (as in antiferromagnets) but are connected by specific spatial rotations or reflections. This unique symmetry coupling between real space (the crystal lattice) and momentum space is what generates the alternating spin-polarized bands (often referred to as d-wave or g-wave magnetism).

Statement 4 is incorrect: Altermagnets do not operate on slow millisecond time scales. Like antiferromagnets, they possess ultra-fast,

15

high-frequency spin dynamics, typically operating in the terahertz (THz) range (picosecond time scales). This ultra-fast switching capability is one of the primary reasons they are highly sought after for next-generation spintronics and high-speed memory devices.

Statement 2 is correct: According to the NARI 2025 report, Kohima (Nagaland) and Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), along with Bhubaneswar (Odisha), topped the index and emerged as the safest cities for women. These cities were recognized for stronger gender equity, civic participation, womenfriendly infrastructure, and reliable policing. In contrast, cities like Patna, Jaipur, Faridabad, Delhi, and Ranchi ranked at the bottom of the safety index.

questions.q: What is the primary objective of the PRATUSH mission proposed by the Raman Research Institute?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct

options.A: Exploring the Martian surface for water
options.B: Probing the Cosmic Dawn using signals from neutral hydrogen
options.C: Analyzing the Sun’s corona and solar flares

questions.explanation:
PRATUSH (Probing Reionization of the Universe using Signal from Hydrogen) is an ambitious spacebased radio telescope project conceptualized by the Raman Research Institute (RRI) in collaboration with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

The mission’s main objective is to detect the extremely faint radio signals (specifically the 21-cm line) emitted by neutral hydrogen atoms from the “Cosmic Dawn.” This is the era when the universe’s first stars and galaxies began to form, bringing an end to the cosmological “Dark Ages.”

questions.q: Which country recently appointed the world’s first AI-generated minister named “Diella” to oversee public tenders and combat corruption?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Albania appointed an AI system to a cabinet-level position—a world-first. Called Diella (Albanian for “sun”), the system was declared “Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence,” and tasked by Albania’s Prime Minister with addressing corruption in government contracting.

The appointment is also being viewed in the context of Albania’s ambition to join the European Union by 2030, for which, cracking down on corruption is a vital condition.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA): 1. It was launched in 2023 on the 50th anniversary of Project Tiger. 2. It focuses on the conservation of seven big cats, including the Jaguar and Puma. 3. Its global headquarters is located in Nairobi, Kenya. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
Statement 1 is correct: The International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in April 2023 in Mysuru, Karnataka, to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the landmark ‘Project Tiger’.

Statement 2 is correct: The core objective of the alliance is to halt the decline and secure the future of the world’s seven major big cats: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, and Puma.

Statement 3 is incorrect: The global headquarters of the IBCA is located in India, not Nairobi, Kenya. The Union Cabinet officially approved its establishment in early 2024, cementing India’s leadership in global wildlife conservation (similar to its role in the International Solar Alliance).

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the Angikaar 2025 campaign: 1. It is an outreach initiative launched under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0). 2. Its primary goal is to accelerate the scheme’s implementation by fasttracking application verification, ensuring the completion of previously sanctioned houses, and reaching vulnerable urban populations across more than 5,000 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the ‘e VITARA’: 1. It is Suzuki’s first global strategic Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) produced in India. 2. The vehicle is manufactured at the Hansalpur plant in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the ‘e-Bhavishya’ initiative: 1. It is a pension reform initiative launched by the Employment Provident Fund Organization (EPFO). 2. questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation:
